notes.title: Isla Sinaloa will be changing to be a paid game soon...
notes.content:
With the latest release we have removed the annual pass and made sharing islands and cross platform backup available to all.  That will allow many more people to share their islands and avoid issues of the game having more functionality for some players.  There are now no purchases within the game.

For the players who bought an annual pass, we appreciate your support very much!  You will continue to get 1,000 moons per day until the end of your year compared to 500 moons per day for all of the rest of the players.  Everything else is now available to all players.  

We have submitted the request to Valve to change it to a paid game and understand that it may take around a week before the game becomes a paid game.  So, if you have not grabbed it already or you want your friends to get it, now is a great time to get it before the change is made.  :)

Thanks for your understanding!
EnsenaSoft Team

notes.title: ISLA SINALOA now supports Mac OS on STEAM
notes.content:
ISLA SINALOA is now available for the Mac OS on STEAM.  While this is arguably not the biggest gaming news on Mac OS ever, it is something we are super excited to announce!   

ISLA SINALOA plays great on the Mac whether you are using keyboard and mouse or using a gamepad controller.

notes.title: New features
notes.content:
1.	Do the Time Warp – restarts the day as if 24 hours have passed.  This allows player to advance their game stories as a much faster pace.
2.	Education Day Pass – this one time pass allows you to see everything in museums, zoo and gardens as if they had all been donated.  
3.	Balloon Ride Camera – you can now move the camera during the free balloon ride (the free one of your own island).  
4.	Rumble support – if an existing game you will need to turn it on in Settings.  It will be on by default if a new game and using controller. 
5.	We have added the ability to move player to start of scene when stuck using the O key or clicking left stick on gamepad or 4 mouse clicks. 
6.	Many bug fixes including problems loading garden scene (was too big), fixes for issues at end of free balloon rides, an issue with a lamp, and an issue with exiting bubble popper if not playing with controller.

notes.title: ISLA SINALOA - HALLOWEEN CELEBRATION
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1D269WGCJRM;full][/previewyoutube]

Double, double, toil and trouble; fire burn and cauldron bubble. In ISLA SINALOA our Halloween celebrations are a real treat! 

Katrina Kat at the zoo, Tarik Tiger at the Museum and Lily Bunny at the Botanical Gardens go all out to compete with each other for best decorations on every holiday.   You decide of who has the best decorations.  Many of the neighbors and stores also decorate for Halloween.

The Roon Store also has many items available that you can purchase to decorate your island or home and use all year long. 

The celebrations start on October 24th and go through November 2nd.  Make sure to play on October 31st itself to get some special news.

Enjoy!
